image_description: A close-up photograph of a young child blowing soap bubbles using a plastic wand. The child is holding the wand in their left hand (viewer's left) and has a large, iridescent bubble forming at their mouth. Several other out-of-focus bubbles float in the background. The lighting creates strong specular highlights on the child's face and the bubbles.

The background bubbles have a slight 'painted' or flattened appearance rather than distinct optical refraction, though this could also be attributed to extreme depth-of-field blur in a real photo.

All testable geometric and functional checkpoints regarding spherical shape, iridescence, reflectivity, and translucency are clearly present and physically accurate. The only non-testable checkpoint relates to dynamic fragility.
